summary.text:
# 巨型艺术设施：完工 / Mega Art Installation: Perfection

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:6552；common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt:347（mega_art_installation_4）、518（mega_art_installation_restored_2） · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics；巨型结构 megastructure 文件 mega_art_installation · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

巨型艺术设施建到最后阶段（mega_art_installation_4，或修复版 mega_art_installation_restored_2）时，on_build_complete 对所有者触发 ancrel.10030（common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt:399、570）。

When a Mega Art Installation reaches its last stage (mega_art_installation_4, or the restored version mega_art_installation_restored_2), on_build_complete fires ancrel.10030 for the owner (common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt:399, 570).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

文本按帝国类型（排外、灭绝性等）有不同版本：“我们的伟大使我们能把无价的文物陈列在展览站上，让异族看看我们的作品而绝望。”单一选项“太好了”，没有后续。

The text has versions by empire (xenophobe, homicidal and others): the greatness of the empire lets it line the Exhibition Stations with priceless artifacts for xenos to despair at. A single option "Excellent" and nothing follows.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无分支。 / No branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 描述按排外与灭绝性帝国分为不同版本。 / The description varies for xenophobe and homicidal empires.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：ancrel.10030 的脚本与两个调用点；中英文正文已读。
- Checked: the script of ancrel.10030 and both call sites; both languages read.
